hooks.command: STDIN=$(cat); ( : >/dev/tty ) 2>/dev/null || exit 0; TOOL=$(printf '%s' "$STDIN" | jq -r '.tool_name // ""'); CMD=$(printf '%s' "$STDIN" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | head -c 60); MSG="Claude needs approval: $TOOL"; if [ -n "$CMD" ]; then MSG="$MSG: $CMD"; fi; printf '\e]9;%s\e\\' "$MSG" > /dev/tty

STDIN=$(cat); ( : >/dev/tty ) 2>/dev/null || exit 0; TRANSCRIPT=$(printf '%s' "$STDIN" | jq -r '.transcript_path // empty'); [ -f "$TRANSCRIPT" ] || exit 0; sleep 0.5; FULL=$(tac "$TRANSCRIPT" | jq -Rr 'fromjson? | select(.type=="assistant") | .message.content[]? | select(.type=="text") | .text' 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -z "$FULL" ] && exit 0; MSG=$(printf '%.50s' "$FULL"); if [ "$MSG" != "$FULL" ]; then MSG="$MSG..."; fi; printf '\e]9;Claude: %s\e\\' "$MSG" > /dev/tty
